name: Expired Document / Lease Failure Escalation
description: Escalation policy when registered lease deed, Fire Safety NOC, or Building Safety Certificate expires without an approved renewed replacement.
aphClauseCitation: APH Chapter I Cl. 1.10 & Chapter II Cl. 2.18

tiers.description: Level 1: Expiration date reached (T-0). Document status auto-switches to EXPIRED. Mandatory Show Cause notice dispatched to Institution.
tiers.actionRequired: Issue Show Cause notice for operating with expired safety/lease certificate.

tiers.description: Level 2: 14 days post-expiration without renewed document. Placed before Standing Hearing Committee to recommend withdrawal of approval.
tiers.actionRequired: Docket institution for punitive regulatory hearing.

autoResolutionCondition: Institution uploads renewed certified document and officer verifies validity.
